takeaway: A new lift-over-chance column explains the weak like-for-like scores: the radar now picks leaders 18-43 times better than chance, against 1.6-3.7 times in October; it orders them less well. Perplexity crossed $1B ARR, and Tencent's WorkBuddy passed 10 million daily users.

findings.heading: Forecasts pick leaders 18-43x better than chance
findings.text: Lift (top-15 hit rate over random picks) is comparable across pool sizes: October 1.6-3.7x, Nov 2-12 18-43x. The lower top-100 Spearman since November reflects a narrow band of leaders, not worse pools: random 100-app samples score 0.82-0.86.

findings.heading: Perplexity: $1B ARR
findings.text: CEO Aravind Srinivas said Perplexity crossed $1B ARR, revealed on Nov 16.

findings.heading: Tencent WorkBuddy: over 10 million daily users
findings.text: Tencent's Q3 release reports over 10 million daily active users for WorkBuddy; on the call, its Q3 revenue was over 5x the previous quarter.

findings.heading: Humyn Labs: over $50M annualised revenue
findings.text: Humyn Labs' Series A release says it surpassed $50M in annualised revenue; a TechCrunch interview gives a smaller figure.

findings.heading: Claude-BugHunter keeps accelerating
findings.text: The bug-hunting skill bundle gained 1,721 stars in a day, to 11,555, up from 1,548 a day.

caveats: Top-100 ordering of the Nov 8-12 forecasts slid from 0.52 to 0.13 while lift held at 29-37x; the cause is still open.
Tencent's $500M annualized WorkMate figure was not recorded: the transcript's product name could not be confirmed as WorkBuddy.
Hacker News and npm remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
